payload.posture: Read Revelation 15:1–8 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states victorious singers, opened sanctuary, seven angels, smoke, glory, and restricted entry precede judgment. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
